corrections.evidence: autotijd lists 'Petrol V40 T5 254 hp' for the V40 2012-2016 (2.5-litre five-cylinder; cars-data/ultimatespecs also list T5 at 254 hp). Applies to the five-cylinder T5 until the Drive-E switch (~MY2015/16, later T5 Drive-E 245 PS - not verified).

missing.detail: Variants not listed: T2 (122 PS), D4 Drive-E 190 PS (from ~MY2015), T5 Drive-E (245 PS) and later T3 152 PS Drive-E; the 2016 facelift is continuous in ADAC (3generation-facelift, 04/16 - 01/20), so yearTo 2019 is fine (ADAC lists production until 01/20).

D2 (1.6 115 PS, later Drive-E 120 PS) variant missing; T5 AWD has 254 PS (cars-data.com / ultimatespecs 'V40 Cross Country T5 AWD 254 hp', 2013); T3 152 PS and D4 190 PS (Drive-E, from MY2016) per Parkers.
D5 (2.4D five-cylinder) diesel, T5 AWD, and 1.8F / 2.0F FlexiFuel petrol variants are not represented as separate variants (2.0F appears in autoscout24 with length 4476).
Facelift D5 and T5 power figures null (T5 facelift 230 PS per auto-data.net '2.5 T5 20V 230hp').
